import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        String s = sc.next();
        StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
        boolean at_replaced = false;
        int n = s.length();
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            if (i > 0 && i + 2 < n) {
                String sub3 = s.substring(i, i + 3);
                if (sub3.equals("dot")) {
                    result.append('.');
                    i += 2;
                    continue;
                }
            }
            
            if (!at_replaced && i > 0 && i + 1 < n) {
                String sub2 = s.substring(i, i + 2);
                if (sub2.equals("at")) {
                    result.append('@');
                    i += 1;
                    at_replaced = true;
                    continue;
                }
            }
            
            result.append(s.charAt(i));
        }
        
        System.out.println(result.toString());
    }
}
